name: Wild & Fiery
overview: Twenty years after a baby-switching scheme separated the Mu family’s true heir from his birthright, Shen Jibai grows up in hardship while Mu Zhiyu returns as a renowned auctioneer determined to reclaim the family auction house from her stepmother. Manipulated into opposing each other, Shen Jibai and Mu Zhiyu are drawn into a web of power and deception, ultimately joining forces to uncover the truth and seek revenge.
